title: Vitamin C could help block cancer-linked chemicals in your stomach, study finds
caption:
A new mathematical model from the University of Waterloo suggests vitamin C could help block the formation of potentially harmful, cancer-linked chemicals in the stomach. While these findings are based on simulations rather than human trials, they offer a new perspective on how diet affects digestive chemistry.

Source: Sciencedaily - Vitamin C could help block cancer-linked chemicals in your stomach, study finds
